properties.name: agent.base-url
properties.description: Private address of agent-service, which keeps the chat. Only this service talks to it. Set with AGENT_BASE_URL.

properties.name: sms.username
properties.description: Africa's Talking username. Use sandbox with the sandbox address. Only used when companion.code-delivery is sms. Set with SMS_USERNAME.

properties.name: sms.api-key
properties.description: Africa's Talking API key. Only used when companion.code-delivery is sms. Set with SMS_API_KEY.

properties.name: sms.sender-id
properties.description: Sender name shown on the sign-in SMS. Leave blank to use the account default. Set with SMS_SENDER_ID.

properties.name: sms.base-url
properties.description: Africa's Talking address. The sandbox address does not reach real phones. Use https://api.africastalking.com with a live key. Set with SMS_BASE_URL.

properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma separated browser origins allowed to call this service, for the test console. Empty means off. Never set this in production. Set with CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

properties.name: internal.key
properties.description: Shared secret between our own services, sent in the X-Internal-Key header. Only agent-service calls /internal/**. Set with INTERNAL_KEY.

properties.name: companion.token-secret
properties.description: Signs the phone app's login tokens and hashes link codes. At least 32 random characters. Set with COMPANION_TOKEN_SECRET.

properties.name: companion.token-ttl
properties.description: How long a phone app login token stays valid. Set with COMPANION_TOKEN_TTL.

properties.name: companion.link-code-ttl
properties.description: How long a sign-in code can be used after it is issued.

properties.name: companion.link-max-attempts
properties.description: Wrong guesses allowed on one sign-in code before it stops working.

properties.name: companion.link-codes-per-hour
properties.description: How many sign-in codes one phone number can ask for per hour. Set with COMPANION_CODES_PER_HOUR.

properties.name: companion.action-ttl
properties.description: How long a wallet request waits for the customer before it expires. Set with COMPANION_ACTION_TTL.

properties.name: companion.max-open-actions
properties.description: Most wallet requests one customer can have open at the same time.

properties.name: companion.max-amount
properties.description: Largest amount in KES a request may carry. M-Pesa's own limits still apply on the phone; this only stops obviously wrong requests. Set with COMPANION_MAX_AMOUNT.

properties.name: companion.min-airtime
properties.description: Smallest airtime purchase in KES.

properties.name: companion.public-base-url
properties.description: Public HTTPS address of this service. Links shown in the chat look like PUBLIC_BASE_URL/a/ACTION_ID. Set with COMPANION_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.

properties.name: companion.android-package
properties.description: Android package name for app links that open the app directly. Leave blank until the app is published. Set with COMPANION_ANDROID_PACKAGE.

properties.name: companion.android-sha256
properties.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the Android signing certificate, for app links. Leave blank until the app is published. Set with COMPANION_ANDROID_SHA256.

properties.name: companion.ios-app-id
properties.description: iOS app id (team id plus bundle id) for app links. Leave blank until the app is published. Set with COMPANION_IOS_APP_ID.

properties.name: companion.code-delivery
properties.description: How sign-in codes reach people. log writes the code to this service's log, for a developer. dev also returns it to the app, for a test console only, never on a real system. sms sends it through Africa's Talking, see the sms block. Set with CODE_DELIVERY.

properties.name: companion.app-name
properties.description: Name shown in the sign-in SMS. Set with COMPANION_APP_NAME.

properties.name: companion.hand-off.ussd-main
properties.description: USSD code that opens the main M-Pesa menu. Verify with the M-Pesa team before relying on it. Set with HANDOFF_USSD_MAIN.

properties.name: companion.hand-off.mpesa-android-package
properties.description: Android package name of the M-Pesa app the phone app opens. Leave blank to fall back to guided steps. Set with HANDOFF_MPESA_ANDROID_PACKAGE.

properties.name: companion.hand-off.mpesa-ios-url
properties.description: URL that opens the M-Pesa app on iOS. Leave blank to fall back to guided steps. Set with HANDOFF_MPESA_IOS_URL.

properties.name: companion.hand-off.ussd-templates
properties.description: USSD string per request type, with the placeholders {amount} {phone} {paybill} {account} {till}. Verify each with the M-Pesa team. The app falls back to guided steps when a template is empty. Keys are SEND_MONEY, PAY_BILL, PAY_TILL and BUY_AIRTIME.

values.description: Write the code to this service's log. For a developer.
Also return the code to the app. For a test console only, never on a real system.
Send the code by SMS through Africa's Talking.
